name: English
lead: Take a brand-new character all the way to a full Tier 8 set on your own — without ever using the marketplace and without receiving anything from other players.
note: This challenge is just for fun. Nobody checks anyone: anyone can join, and honesty is a personal challenge to yourself.

ul: Create a new character. Starting with an already leveled character is not allowed.
Play by the rules below. If a situation is not covered, decide by the two principles.
Share your progress in the {twitch} chat.

principles: Everything the game itself gives you is allowed. Everything that comes through the marketplace or from other players is forbidden.
Everything your character wears, eats, drinks and rides is made by that character. Upgrades also come only from your own crafting.

p: The marketplace is completely forbidden. You may buy gold, but you may not exchange it back to silver: that way no silver can be brought in from outside.

ul: Buying anything on the marketplace: from sell orders or through buy orders
Selling anything on the marketplace: to other players' buy orders or through your own sell orders
Selling to the Black Market in Caerleon
Exchanging gold for silver
Buying gold with silver or with real money
Transferring silver from your main account, but only for Premium: exactly the gold price of Premium at the exchange rate at the time of purchase, spent right away
Premium and all of its bonuses
Buying an island and its upgrades with silver — that is not the marketplace
Paying silver for repairs, station fees and other game services

p: Any activity with other players is allowed, including large-scale content, and help in combat is fine. The only thing forbidden is receiving valuables from players, directly or indirectly. Guilds and parties are forbidden because shared fame and silver flow through them. Loot from killed players is game loot and is allowed.

ul: Trading with players in any form
Accepting gifts: items, resources, silver
Picking up silver that players drop on the ground
Dueling for silver: it is hidden trading
Using alts or transferring anything from other characters (except silver for Premium)
Joining a guild
Being in a party outside of a city
Talking to players
Taking part in large-scale and open-world activities without joining a party
Helping others and accepting help in combat
Fighting players and taking loot from the ones you kill
Using other players' stations for the normal usage fee

p: Everything your character wears or uses is crafted by that character. You may not equip a finished item you found, even if you can craft it yourself. The starting equipment is crafted by the player in the tutorial, so it is allowed.

ul: Weapon, off-hand, head, armor, shoes
Bag and cape
Tools and gathering gear
Food and potions
Mounts (section 6)
Wearing or using finished equipment that you found, looted or received as a reward
Eating or drinking food and potions you found
Using tools you found

p: Any game loot is allowed as raw material for your own crafting: mobs and bosses, chests in the open world, dungeons and mists, faction and seasonal chests, killed players, rewards for quests and journals.

ul: Resources — raw and refined, including enchanted ones
Artifacts; runes, souls and relics — only to make artifacts
Tomes of insight
Silver bags and silver from mobs
Baby animals and seeds
Finished equipment, tools, bags, capes
Finished food, potions and mounts
cols.p: Salvage them for resources or for silver at the repair station.

p: An item only gets better if you craft it again from better materials — never by upgrading it at an NPC.

ul: Any crafting and refining stations: in cities, on islands, in hideouts and in black zone cities, including other players' stations
Focus for crafting and refining
Turning runes, souls and relics into artifacts
Crafting enchanted items from enchanted resources
Repairing items at the repair station
Raising item quality at the repair station: quality is only what you got when crafting
Enchanting finished items with runes, souls and relics
Upgrading the enchantment of resources (for example, from .0 to .1)

p: At the start you only have the starter mule. Every other mount has to be raised or tamed and saddled by yourself.

ul: An island and its upgrades for silver; farms, pastures and stations on the island
Seeds and baby animals from game sources: your own farm, gathering, loot, rewards
The starter mule
Mounts you raised or tamed yourself: oxen, horses, wild mounts
Faction mounts: they are also raised and saddled by yourself
Seasonal mounts: they come already saddled
Finished mounts that were bought, gifted or found

p: There is no penalty: lose your set — craft a new one. You make your own gear anyway; that is the whole point of the challenge.
